rows.note: Use this for giving sworn evidence in court or to the police.

example.english: The defendant took the stand to testify and explain what happened that night.
example.traditional: 被告喺庭上宣誓作供，講清楚當晚發生咩事。
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 hai2 ting4 soeng6 syun1 sai6 zok3 gung1 gong2 cing1 co2 dong1 maan5 faat3 sang1 me1 si6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for formally giving testimony or supporting a statement with evidence.

example.english: This report can testify that the work was not poorly done.
example.traditional: 呢份報告可以作證，證明工程冇偷工減料。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ho2 ji5 zok3 zing3 zing3 ming4 gung1 cing4 mou5 tau1 gung1 gaam2 liu2

rows.note: Use this when someone bears witness from personal experience or faith, especially in religious or solemn contexts.

example.english: I can testify from personal experience to how this church helps local residents.
example.traditional: 我親身見證呢間教會點樣幫助街坊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 can1 san1 gin3 zing3 ne1 gaan1 gaau3 wui2 dim2 joeng2 bong1 zo6 gaai1 fong1
